PushBoxGame.__init__:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Initializes a Sokoban game instance by binding the provided map, setting the player's starting position to the top-left corner, creating empty collections for targets and boxes, zeroing the target counter, marking the game as in progress, and then delegating further game setup to init_game." __init__]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> map </REF>: object "The game map structure passed in by the caller; stored as a live reference with no defensive copy, so external mutations will be reflected in self.map"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Assign self.map to the map parameter as a direct reference (no copy made; aliasing risk if map is mutable) RESULT self.map]
            [COMMAND Set self.player_row to integer constant 0, placing the player at the top edge of the map RESULT self.player_row]
            [COMMAND Set self.player_col to integer constant 0, placing the player at the left edge of the map RESULT self.player_col]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.targets to a new empty list; this list will be populated during map parsing and is independent of all other instances RESULT self.targets]
            [COMMAND Initialize self.boxes to a new empty list; this list will be populated during map parsing and is independent of all other instances RESULT self.boxes]
            [COMMAND Set self.target_count to integer constant 0; this counter must be kept manually in sync with len(self.targets) by whichever code populates targets RESULT self.target_count]
            [COMMAND Set self.is_game_over to boolean constant False, indicating the game is currently in progress; this sentinel must be checked by the game loop after every move RESULT self.is_game_over]
            [COMMAND Call self.init_game() to perform further game initialization such as parsing the map, locating tiles, and populating self.targets, self.boxes, and self.target_count RESULT init_game_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PushBoxGame.init_game:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Scans the full 2D map grid in row-major order to locate and record the player's starting position, all target (goal) cell coordinates, and all box cell coordinates into the corresponding game state fields." init_game]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self.map </REF>: list[list[str]] "2D grid of single-character strings representing the game board; may be jagged (rows of unequal length)"
        <REF> self.targets </REF>: list[tuple[int, int]] "Pre-existing list that will be extended with (row, col) tuples for every cell marked 'G'"
        <REF> self.target_count </REF>: int "Pre-existing counter that will be incremented once for each 'G' cell found"
        <REF> self.boxes </REF>: list[tuple[int, int]] "Pre-existing list that will be extended with (row, col) tuples for every cell marked 'X'"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> self.player_row </REF>: int "Row index of the player's starting position; set to the last 'O' cell found in reading order if multiple exist"
        <REF> self.player_col </REF>: int "Column index of the player's starting position; set to the last 'O' cell found in reading order if multiple exist"
        <REF> self.targets </REF>: list[tuple[int, int]] "Populated list of (row, col) tuples for every goal cell in the map"
        <REF> self.target_count </REF>: int "Final count of goal cells found; incremented in sync with self.targets"
        <REF> self.boxes </REF>: list[tuple[int, int]] "Populated list of (row, col) tuples for every box cell in the map"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Iterate over each row index from 0 to len(self.map) - 1 inclusive using the outer for loop variable 'row' RESULT row_iterator]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop for each 'row', iterate over each column index from 0 to len(self.map[row]) - 1 inclusive using the inner for loop variable 'col'; re-evaluate len(self.map[row]) on every outer iteration so jagged rows are handled correctly RESULT col_iterator]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop for the current (row, col), read the cell value self.map[row][col] and test whether it equals the string 'O' RESULT is_player_cell]
            [COMMAND If is_player_cell is true, overwrite self.player_row with the current value of 'row' and overwrite self.player_col with the current value of 'col'; no duplicate guard is applied, so a later 'O' cell will silently replace an earlier one RESULT player_position_recorded]
            [COMMAND If is_player_cell is false, test whether self.map[row][col] equals the string 'G' (first elif branch) RESULT is_goal_cell]
            [COMMAND If is_goal_cell is true, append the tuple (row, col) to self.targets and increment self.target_count by exactly 1, keeping the two fields in sync RESULT goal_cell_recorded]
            [COMMAND If is_goal_cell is false, test whether self.map[row][col] equals the string 'X' (second elif branch) RESULT is_box_cell]
            [COMMAND If is_box_cell is true, append the tuple (row, col) to self.boxes RESULT box_cell_recorded]
            [COMMAND If none of the three conditions matched, take no action for this cell and advance to the next column index RESULT cell_skipped]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: The map contains more than one cell with value 'O']
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Each subsequent 'O' cell encountered in row-major order overwrites self.player_row and self.player_col without error; the final values reflect the last 'O' position in reading order RESULT player_position_last_o_wins]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: self.map is empty (zero rows) or a given row is empty (zero columns)]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND range(len(self.map)) or range(len(self.map[row])) evaluates to an empty range; the corresponding loop body is never entered and no state is modified RESULT empty_iteration_skipped]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PushBoxGame.check_win:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Counts how many boxes are positioned on targets and sets the game-over flag to true if that count equals the total target count, then returns the current game-over state." check_win]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> self </REF>: object "The game state object carrying boxes (iterable of positions), targets (collection of target positions), target_count (integer total number of targets), and is_game_over (boolean win flag)"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> is_game_over </REF>: boolean "True if all boxes are on targets (win condition met), otherwise the current value of is_game_over which may already be True from a prior call or False if the win condition is not yet satisfied"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Initialize a local integer counter box_on_target_count to 0 RESULT box_on_target_count]
            [COMMAND Iterate over every element box in self.boxes; for each box, test membership of box in self.targets; if the membership test is True, increment box_on_target_count by 1; if False, do nothing and advance to the next box RESULT box_on_target_count]
            [COMMAND After the loop completes, compare box_on_target_count to self.target_count using strict equality (==); if they are equal, set self.is_game_over to True RESULT self.is_game_over]
            [COMMAND Return self.is_game_over RESULT is_game_over]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: box_on_target_count does not equal self.target_count after the loop — the win condition is not met]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip the assignment of True to self.is_game_over and proceed directly to the return statement, returning the current value of self.is_game_over unchanged RESULT self.is_game_over]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
PushBoxGame.move:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Moves the player one step in the given WASD direction on a grid map, pushing a box one further step in the same direction if the target cell is occupied by one, provided neither the player's nor the box's destination is a wall." move]
    [INPUTS]
        <REF> direction </REF>: string "Single-character WASD input indicating the intended movement direction: 'w' = up, 's' = down, 'a' = left, 'd' = right"
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
        <REF> result </REF>: boolean "Return value of check_win(), indicating whether the current box configuration satisfies the win condition"
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Copy self.player_row into local variable new_player_row and self.player_col into local variable new_player_col to create a candidate next position without mutating object state RESULT new_player_row, new_player_col]
            [COMMAND Evaluate the direction input against the four WASD cases: if 'w', decrement new_player_row by 1; else if 's', increment new_player_row by 1; else if 'a', decrement new_player_col by 1; else if 'd', increment new_player_col by 1; if direction matches none of these, leave both candidate coordinates unchanged RESULT new_player_row, new_player_col]
            [COMMAND Check whether the cell at self.map[new_player_row][new_player_col] is not equal to '#'; if it is '#', skip all movement logic and proceed to the return statement RESULT wall_check_passed]
            [COMMAND Within the wall-check-passed branch, check whether the tuple (new_player_row, new_player_col) is present in self.boxes to determine if a box occupies the target cell RESULT box_present]
            [COMMAND Within the box-present sub-branch, compute the box's candidate destination: new_box_row = new_player_row + (new_player_row - self.player_row) and new_box_col = new_player_col + (new_player_col - self.player_col), which projects one additional step in the same movement direction RESULT new_box_row, new_box_col]
            [COMMAND Within the box-present sub-branch, check whether the cell at self.map[new_box_row][new_box_col] is not equal to '#'; if it is '#', the push is blocked and neither the box nor the player moves RESULT box_destination_clear]
            [COMMAND Within the box-destination-clear sub-branch, remove the tuple (new_player_row, new_player_col) from self.boxes and append the tuple (new_box_row, new_box_col) to self.boxes, then update self.player_row to new_player_row and self.player_col to new_player_col RESULT self.boxes, self.player_row, self.player_col]
            [COMMAND Within the no-box branch (wall check passed but target cell has no box), update self.player_row to new_player_row and self.player_col to new_player_col directly RESULT self.player_row, self.player_col]
            [COMMAND Call self.check_win() and return its result RESULT win_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: direction is not one of 'w', 's', 'a', or 'd']
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Leave new_player_row and new_player_col unchanged so the candidate position equals the current position; the subsequent wall check will read the player's current cell, which is never '#' under normal game state, so the player remains stationary and check_win() is still called and returned RESULT new_player_row, new_player_col]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Target cell self.map[new_player_row][new_player_col] equals '#']
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Skip all position and box update logic entirely; proceed immediately to calling self.check_win() and returning its result RESULT win_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

    [ALTERNATIVE_FLOW: Target cell contains a box and the box's destination cell self.map[new_box_row][new_box_col] equals '#']
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Block both the box push and the player move; neither self.boxes nor self.player_row/self.player_col are modified; proceed to calling self.check_win() and returning its result RESULT win_result]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_ALTERNATIVE_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
